scope: Opt-in local native typing history through Wasm, vanilla/React SDK and DOM; two reproduced asynchronous caret repairs; original shared-history visibility prerequisites.

contracts.admission: history: typing-v1 is immutable initial local configuration for either rich language. Omitted/explicit preserves original behavior. Admission happens before initial read-only policy and mounting. Requested capability or grouped recovery fails on older runtimes without JS-history fallback, leaking an owner or claiming the host.
contracts.wasm: Additive exact-version capability, guarded enable/close and separate insertTypingText/deleteTypingRange data commands. clockMs is a strict canonical decimal u64 string; numeric, signed, fractional, overflowing, duplicate and unknown fields reject. Frozen views add historyGrouping/historyStepCount only after opt-in; original default view bytes remain unchanged.
contracts.recovery: New checkpoints use the separate breditor/rich-typing-session v1 family. typingCheckpoint and restoreTypingEditor explicitly select that family; original checkpoint/restoreEditor remain strict. Original recovery plus explicit new-mode admission retains old entries as singleton units. Exact grouped future Undo/Redo survives recovery, but active continuation does not. Read-only remains host policy reapplied after restore.
contracts.input: Only collapsed-caret insertText and valid directional caret-adjacent deletion targets use native natural input. Paste, replacement, composition, hard breaks and programmatic edits remain explicit. Navigation, unchanged-caret pointer/blur and toolbar intent close continuation without rendering or moving focus. Native 750 ms, 64-step, scalar, format, capacity, revision and atomicity rules are unchanged.
contracts.react: Parent renders retain the same owner and checkpoint. Initial history configuration is not a live prop. The imperative closeTypingGroup method delegates to the native guarded boundary.
contracts.shared: Shared natural history is not implemented. The shared SDK accepts only explicit history and rejects unsupported policy before startup. Original causal models, update frames, journals, writer lineage, engine wall-clock configuration and application exports remain unchanged.
contracts.visibilityPrerequisites: Three new canonical native tests in both shared languages prove that one engine Undo can skip multiple remotely invisible owned keys, that a false result may still change stacks/publication, and that blindly issuing one call per original typing event can cross an older explicit boundary. Exact recovered future history is compared. These are prerequisites, not shared grouping acceptance.

reproducedRepairs.cause: An asynchronous focus:false image insertion replaced editable children without restoring the already-owned DOM caret. Rust retained the task caret, but the browser range collapsed to the root; the next beforeinput adopted the first heading and inserted there.
reproducedRepairs.before: Corrected-seed reproduction fails all six explicit/natural V2 image cases across Chromium, Firefox and WebKit. Trace shows native task-a-head offset 2 versus browser root offset 0, followed by native intro offset 1 after C. No Rust command error.
reproducedRepairs.repair: Capture whether the surface owns focus before command publication. Restore the native selection after rendering when focus was already owned, including focus:false work; do not steal an outside control's focus.

reproducedRepairs.cause: Firefox emitted selectionchange for a temporary collapsed range left by background rendering while the Save button held focus. Unconditional document-level syncing overwrote Rust's retained caret with intro offset 0. Returning focus and typing C inserted in that heading.
reproducedRepairs.before: The outside-focus case reproduces in Firefox; the trace records active save and Rust intro offset 0 before editor.focus. The same run passes in Chromium/WebKit. The first repair alone passes 41/42 cases, exposing this independent case.
reproducedRepairs.repair: Sync browser selection only while this surface or its descendant owns focus. Background rendering cannot reinterpret a leftover range as user editor intent.

browserChecks.policy: Every discovered file runs once in the complete bounded matrix: all three engines, one worker, zero retries and unchanged 60-second case/300-second process deadlines. The focused run overlaps these cases, not additional feature coverage.
browserChecks.coverage: Both local languages, trusted keyboard bursts, real pause, backward/forward deletion, caption/code input, explicit and natural image insertion, immediate typing, exact grouped checkpoint/reload/future history, declared recovery, native read-only denial, pointer/navigation/blur/toolbar boundaries and React ownership. Existing structural, storage lifecycle, peer/offline/reconnect and real asset checks also remain passing.
browserChecks.limits: Paste/drop/composition events in the new cases are synthetic. Trusted browser keyboard is not physical OS IME, native clipboard or screen-reader qualification. Shared natural grouping and general cross-container selections are not implemented by this checkpoint.

nativeAndPackageChecks.note: Existing vendored HasIdSpan warning remains unchanged. Vendor sources, dependencies, lockfiles, default browser archive and shared runtime were not changed. Full research/all-features and release performance qualification are not claimed.

failedAttempts: The first expanded image run exposed missing C and an incorrect Ship-versus-Write seed expectation. After correcting the seed, the six-case before run still fails. The first caret repair passes 41/42, with Firefox outside-focus failure; its separate focused before run passes 2/fails 1. Both repairs together pass 42 focused and all 225 installed cases without weakening the retained immediate-typing assertions.
